data.one_liner: A Dart library for implementing the BLoC pattern with Cubits and Blocs.
data.what_it_does: It provides a lightweight, reactive state management solution that separates business logic from UI. The library defines Bloc and Cubit classes that emit state changes through streams, enabling easy testing and composability.
use_when: Implementing the BLoC pattern in Flutter or Dart apps
Managing complex state with clear separation from UI
avoid_when: Very small or simple apps where a simpler state solution suffices
Projects that require heavy UI logic inside widgets
strengths: High testability and clear separation of concerns
Supports both Bloc and Cubit for flexibility
weaknesses: Requires understanding of streams and reactive patterns
Some boilerplate for setting up Blocs/Cubits
